from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u006/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-9ce200ab.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        positions = [c for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != bg]
        for a, b in zip(positions, positions[1:]):
            if b - a == 2 and row[a] == row[b]:
                out[r][a + 1] = 2
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
print(program_path.read_text())
